prompt:
Make ONE replacement pose, editing the FIRST reference. Preserve its head, horns, torso, mane, tail, fur colors, armor, pixel texture, exact body location, size and transparent square canvas. The SECOND reference is a calculated skeleton guide; do not copy diagram art or colored lines. THIRD reference is canonical creature identity. This is frame 6 of a SIX-frame diagonal TROT cycle. NEAR OPEN, FAR CLOSED. Crucial contact state: BRIGHT NEAR LEFT FRONT paw is GROUNDED and DARK FAR RIGHT HIND paw is GROUNDED. BRIGHT NEAR LEFT HIND paw is LIFTED, DARK FAR RIGHT FRONT paw is LIFTED.
Anatomy: NEAR FRONT leg is the bright foreground leg under the big visible shoulder, typically to the RIGHT of the dark foreground-overlapped front leg in the image. FAR FRONT is the smaller dark leg behind that shoulder, typically LEFT of it. NEAR HIND is the bright leg attached to the visible rear haunch, usually RIGHTMOST rear leg. FAR HIND is the smaller dark rear leg behind it, usually left of it and largely occluded. Do not swap leg identity. LIFTED means curl the paw up 30-45 local pixels ABOVE its own support-plane level; GROUNDED means straighten into its own existing support-plane level. Lifted paw should NOT be drawn at the same height as its grounded neighbor. There are exactly FOUR legs and FOUR feet, every foot connected through ankle/shin/knee/thigh to its correct shoulder/hip; a hidden far limb may overlap, no fifth foot. Small smooth forward/back stride, far hind stride smaller than near hind, no wide spread. For closed near phase near fore retracts toward hip, near hind advances toward shoulder; for open near phase near fore advances toward muzzle, near hind retracts toward tail. Far side is opposite. Follow guide poses and depth; keep artwork body fixed. Coordinate targets local normalized1024: LF bottom=349,894 GROUND; RF bottom=357,847 AIR; LH bottom=713,848 AIR; RH bottom=625,840 GROUND. These coordinates describe proportions/ordering; map into source size without moving the body. Only legs change. Return ONE full creature transparent PNG in SAME square canvas, no floor, labels, guide lines, background or shadow.
selectionReason: Four connected legs and alternating diagonal support reviewed; canonical appearance retained.
